concept.hr: Dubina reda i veličina bloka mijenjaju IOPS, propusnost i kašnjenje
concept.en: Queue depth and block size trade IOPS, throughput and latency off

summary.hr: Biraj uređaj, blok i dubinu reda: dok ima slobodnih traka, IOPS raste; kad su pune ili je dosegnut strop propusnosti, raste samo kašnjenje.
summary.en: Choose the device, block and queue depth: while lanes are free, IOPS rise; once they are full or bandwidth is at its ceiling, only latency grows.

title.en: HDD: a deeper queue only waits
